title: IconDefinition - Data API
description: Represents the icon-related metadata for a custom tab. This object is available in API version 43.0 and later.

ContentType.description: The tab icon’s content type, for example, “image/png.”

DurableId.description: A unique virtual Salesforce ID for the icon.

Height.description: The tab icon’s height in pixels. If the icon content type is an SVG type, height and width values are not used.

TabDefinitionId.description: The TabDefinition ID. This is a relationship field.

Url.description: The fully qualified URL for this icon.

Width.description: The tab icon’s width in pixels. If the icon content type is an SVG type, height and width values are not used.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="IconDefinition">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="ContentType" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="DurableId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Height" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="TabDefinition" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:TabDefinition"/>
        <element name="TabDefinitionId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Theme" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Url" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Width" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```
